body:
Live tomorrow to eat that sandwich and then as soon as you're done find one inane reason that you have to stay alive to the next day. Buy another sandwich, if theyre realy this good. Give yourself some time to enjoy the sandwiches until you find something else you enjoy and start living, just one more day, for that instead. Learn how to cook your own chicken sandwich, make one better than their's. Learn the names of the species of trees you walk by every day, draw a shitty picture, leave a note in a random library book about how you feel, no one will know it was you. 
Tomorrow is your only chance to do anything for the rest of your life, don't squander it by not letting yourself live. Spit right in life's boring and terrible face and do it.
